mapper.sql: select id, source_platform_name, source_platform_code, source_enabled, target_platform_name, target_platform_code, target_enabled, mapping_enabled, sort_num from mark_platform_mapping
mapper.insert: insert into mark_platform_mapping (source_platform_name, source_platform_code, source_enabled, target_platform_name, target_platform_code, target_enabled, mapping_enabled, sort_num) values (#{sourcePlatformName}, #{sourcePlatformCode}, #{sourceEnabled}, #{targetPlatformName}, #{targetPlatformCode}, #{targetEnabled}, #{mappingEnabled}, #{sortNum})
mapper.update: update mark_platform_mapping set source_platform_name=#{sourcePlatformName}, source_platform_code=#{sourcePlatformCode}, target_platform_name=#{targetPlatformName}, target_platform_code=#{targetPlatformCode}, sort_num=#{sortNum} where id=#{id}
update mark_platform_mapping set source_enabled=#{enabled} where id=#{id}
update mark_platform_mapping set target_enabled=#{enabled} where id=#{id}
update mark_platform_mapping set source_platform_name=#{name} where source_platform_code=#{code}
update mark_platform_mapping set target_platform_name=#{name} where target_platform_code=#{code}
update mark_platform_mapping set sort_num=#{sortNum} where source_platform_code=#{code}
update mark_platform_mapping set mapping_enabled=#{enabled} where id=#{id}
